last_session.text: The party reached Brandonsford at sunset, following a treasure map to places they did not recognize.
Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into town every night.
Dunk spent the night drinking with Farmer Gill, who told how Sir Brandon slew a dragon centuries ago.
Eric the Reeve offered a bounty for the dragon. Sir Phidipaldi then slapped him with a glove and challenged him to a duel, which Eric did not accept.
Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to work for Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.
Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn, who runs the Golden Egg, find out who empties his ale each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.
Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale each night and collect his 100 gold.
Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter, says that if the party pays her, she will join them to hunt the dragon.
If Dr. Uriah hires Drop Dead Ned for 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will take any job. Ned insists on getting to kill people with the wasp.
If Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn stage their fake ale delivery, they may spot whoever comes for the ale.
Where are the map's marked locations, and which one holds the treasure?
Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?
What happened to Bentley's overdue shipment, and why has nothing reached town in months?
Where did this new dragon come from?
The black dragon tore off the woodsman George's arm and may maim or kill others, including Farmer Gill's three sons, who are hunting it.
